summary: Completes the central subsystem inventory and enforces consistent names, versions, manifest coverage and UI visibility.

checks.detail: All core JavaScript files pass syntax validation.
Every registered subsystem has a unique ID, official display name, version, owner and manifest mapping.
Every versioned subsystem in platform-manifest.json is represented in the Subsystem Registry.
Platform Intelligence renders the complete registry without a manually maintained allow-list.
Project Brain, Diagnostics Framework, Configuration Service and Governance Service are the canonical user-facing names.
Complete replacement package; preserve only .git and images.
